verdict.rationale: Docs confirm invitee-initiated cancellation (webhook payloads triggered 'when events are scheduled or canceled by either the host or the invitee') and reschedule mechanics, plus multi-calendar sync so availability/updates propagate everywhere. Community evidence corroborates the core value (checking multiple calendars, reserving time slots) though no source shows explicit UI screenshots of the invitee confirmation page controls or granular 'policy enforcement' rules (e.g., cancellation windows). Missing for 10: direct documentation/screenshot of the invitee-facing reschedule/cancel button on the confirmation page, and explicit description of configurable cancellation/reschedule policies enforced at that step.
